raw.title: Microsoft Purview Senior Consultant (m/w/d)
raw.description:
Who are we?

It all starts with the mission: NVISO is here to protect European society from potentially devastating cyber attacks! This means we offer cyber security services to private and governmental organizations to help them better prepare for, prevent, detect and respond to cyber security incidents.

All of this is built on four fundamental values that define who we are: We are Proud, We Break Barriers, We Care and No BS!

Tasks

As a Microsoft Purview Senior Consultant (m/w/d) based in Germany, you will help our customers protect, govern and ensure compliance on the use of their data. Working alongside senior Purview experts, you will translate business, legal and regulatory requirements into concrete Microsoft Purview configurations across Microsoft 365 and Azure. You will spend most of your time hands-on: configuring sensitivity labels, deploying Data Loss Prevention policies, setting up retention rules and tuning classifications, always with a strong focus on user experience and operational stability.

This role is a natural next step for security consultants with 3 – 4 years of IT security experience who want to specialize in Microsoft data security and compliance. You will grow through customer engagements, coaching from more senior colleagues and continuous learning, with a clear path towards a Purview Expert role.

You will contribute to Microsoft Purview projects across the full delivery lifecycle. Your day-to-day tasks will typically include:

  • Classification & Labelling: Configure and deploy sensitivity labels, sensitive information types and auto-labelling policies in Microsoft Purview, based on designs prepared with other consultants. Support pilot rollouts and iterate based on user feedback.
  • Data Loss Prevention (DLP): Implement DLP policies across Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams and endpoints. Tune rules to balance protection with usability, analyse alerts and reduce false positives.
  • Data Retention & Records Management: Build retention labels and policies that map to the customer’s legal, regulatory and contractual obligations. Assist in disposition reviews and lifecycle management scenarios.
  • Insider Risk & Compliance Monitoring: Assist in configuring Insider Risk Management, Communication Compliance and audit / eDiscovery use cases, and help operational teams interpret the resulting signals.
  • Integration with the Microsoft Security Stack: Configure the interactions between Purview and Defender for Cloud Apps, Defender for Endpoint and Microsoft Entra, contributing to an end-to-end Defender XDR data protection story.
  • Documentation & Handover: Produce clear design documents, configuration baselines, runbooks and knowledge transfer material so that customer teams can operate the solution after go-live.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with customer stakeholders (IT, Security, Legal, DPO, Compliance) as well as internal NVISO teams to gather requirements, validate designs and demo solutions.
  • Support & Continuous Improvement: Provide second-line support on Purview deployments, be familiar8 with the Microsoft Purview roadmap and related technologies and continuously improve the delivery approach and reusable material.

Requirements

  • 3 – 4 years of professional experience in IT security, including exposure to Microsoft 365. Azure or cloud security in general is considered a plus.
  • Purview hands-on experience with at least one year working with Microsoft Purview capabilities: sensitivity labels, DLP, retention, eDiscovery, Insider Risk and/or Data Governance; in a customer or enterprise environment.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Data Science or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • You hold citizenship in one of the 32 NATO member states.

Technical Skills

  • Solid working knowledge of the Microsoft 365 platform (Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Teams) and a good understanding of the Microsoft Entra identity model.
  • Familiarity with the Microsoft Purview portal and its core solutions: Information Protection, Data Loss Prevention, Data Lifecycle Management and Records Management.
  • Understanding of how Purview integrates with Defender for Cloud Apps, Defender for Endpoint and the broader Defender XDR ecosystem.
  • Basic scripting skills in PowerShell (Exchange Online, Security & Compliance) to automate deployment, reporting and troubleshooting tasks.
  • Regulatory & Domain Knowledge
  • Working knowledge of data protection regulations such as GDPR, and awareness of frameworks like NIS2, ISO/IEC 27001 and DORA and how they translate into data protection controls.
  • Ability to translate legal and business requirements into concrete data classification, DLP and retention rules.

Soft Skills & Languages

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and to write clear documentation.
  • Fluency in spoken and written German and English
  • A consulting mindset: curious, structured, customer-focused and comfortable working on several engagements in parallel.

Nice to Have

  • Microsoft certifications such as SC-401 (Information Protection and Compliance Administrator), SC-200 or AZ-500.
  • Other Data Privacy related certifications
  • Experience with adjacent security tooling (Microsoft Sentinel, third-party DLP or CASB solutions) and with change management around end-user security controls.

Benefits

At NVISO, we care. We are committed to offering you a highly competitive remuneration package including financial and non-financial components:

  • Working and learning from the best people in the European cyber security industry. We have multiple SANS Instructors working at NVISO, our staff has presented at popular hacking conferences (BlackHat, BruCON, OWASP, etc) and all of our technical staff can acquire deep technical security certifications (GSE, GXPN, GREM, GCFA, OSCP, etc);

raw.description:
We actively encourage applications from women and underrepresented genders in tech. Diverse teams build better products. And we mean it.

Education is one of the hardest nuts to crack, and that's exactly what makes it worth it. At OneTutor, we combine startup velocity with real impact: AI tools that help people actually learn better. That takes taste, thoughtfulness, attention to detail, and an evidence-based way of working, because in education, close enough isn't good enough.

As Founding Growth Marketer, you'll work directly with our growth founder to build our brand, growth engine, and community. You already know what you're doing, bring some real experience, and are fired up to own something that matters. You think in evidence, not assumptions. You sweat the details because they're the difference between something people use and something people trust.

Tasks

Demand & Growth

  • Generate B2B demand. Increase awareness for OneTutor as a SaaS and AI partner on LinkedIn, at in-person events, press, and beyond.
  • Contribute to growth. Own and execute the inbound growth engine end-to-end. Set strategy across all channels including SEO, paid, content, and product marketing.
  • Learn from data. Track, measure, and report on all campaigns; set KPIs, run experiments, iterate fast, and communicate results across the organisation.

Brand & Content

  • Own the brand. Evolve OneTutor's brand, positioning, and visual presence. Ensure consistency across every touchpoint, working closely with founders, agencies, and stakeholders.
  • Drive the website. Treat our website as a primary growth and conversion channel; develop it continuously.
  • Translate complexity into clarity. Turn complex AI topics into compelling stories and visuals that resonate with educators and decision-makers.
  • Produce assets. Create presentations, landing pages, campaign materials, event collateral, and other brand assets, hands-on, end to end.

Events & Community

  • Run the show. Roundtables, conferences, and webinars: you own events end-to-end, from first idea to last follow-up, and conceive and host formats for educators and customers.
  • Build the community. Help build the go-to community for AI in education. Not a mailing list. A space people identify with, learn from, and keep coming back to.

Requirements

Demand & Growth

  • Data-driven. You make decisions based on facts and analytically evaluate the success of experiments and campaigns.

Brand & Content

  • Exceptional taste. You bring exceptional taste and attention to detail in everything you produce.
  • Execute and elevate. You can take an existing vision and make it better, not just pitch your own ideas.
  • Relevant experience. You've worked in marketing, brand, or content, ideally in a startup or as an early marketing hire.

Events & Community

  • You've run things people showed up for. You've organized events or initiatives that people genuinely loved, and you're hungry for more.
  • A natural connector. You bring people together and build relationships that last.
  • Bonus: you've built something of your own. A project, a community, or a side hustle. You know what it means to start from zero.

How you work

  • Entrepreneurial and scrappy. You don't wait for permission or perfect conditions. You run MVPs, see what works, kill what doesn't, and ship again. You roll up your sleeves. No job is too small.
  • You work hard. You do what needs to get done. No ego, no excuses. This isn't a 9-to-5. If that sounds miserable, this isn't for you. If it sounds exciting, you'll fit right in.
  • Reliable and detail-oriented. When you own something, it's done right, on time, fully thought through, and at a high quality bar.
  • Teamplayer. You work seamlessly across teams. Sales, product, team members, and partners: you align stakeholders, keep everyone in the loop, and make things happen across functions.

Practical

  • Languages: Native or fluent in German and English.
  • Location: Working on-site in our Munich office right next to Theresienwiese.
  • Duration: 4–6 months, full-time.

Benefits

  • Full-time outlook: Perform well, and we'll offer you a full-time role with competitive salary after the internship.
  • Subsidized EGYM Wellpass (fitness) and Deutschlandticket Job
  • Cool office next to Theresienwiese, central Munich
  • A small team where your voice genuinely shapes product decisions from day one
  • Active mentorship and a culture where learning is part of the job, not an afterthought
  • Work that directly improves educational outcomes for tens of thousands of learners

We are looking forward to your application! Please attach your employment references, applications lacking these might not be processed.

OneTutor is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We particularly welcome applications from women and people of underrepresented genders in tech. We believe balanced teams make better decisions and build better products.

description: Beschreibung Führender weclapp-Partner in Deutschland: Kleine und mittelständische Unternehmen kommen zu uns, wenn sie ihr ERP nicht nur einführen, sondern ihre Abläufe neu denken wollen. Du sitzt direkt mit Geschäftsführung und Fachbereichen am Tisch, entscheidest mit und siehst nach wenigen Wochen ein laufendes System mit echten Ergebnissen. Dann das nächste Unternehmen, die nächste Branche, das nächste Prozessmodell. Dazu bauen wir auf weclapp eine KI-gestützte Automatisierungsschicht: Agenten, die Belege verarbeiten, Buchhaltung vorbereiten und Prozesse überwachen. Als Consultant bei uns berätst du nicht das ERP von gestern, sondern gestaltest, wie der Mittelstand morgen arbeitet. Deine Aufgaben End-to-End-Projektverantwortung: Du führst weclapp bei unseren Kunden ein und verantwortest von der Prozessaufnahme über Konzeption und Konfiguration bis zum Go-live und darüber hinaus. Vollständig, nicht ausschnittweise. Prozessberatung auf Augenhöhe: Du analysierst Geschäftsprozesse quer durch alle Bereiche (Vertrieb, Einkauf, Lager, Projektabwicklung, Fibu), erkennst Optimierungspotenzial und übersetzt es in saubere ERP-Lösungen. Workshops & Schulungen: Du moderierst Anforderungsworkshops, schulst Key-User und Anwender und begleitest den Echtstart vor Ort oder remote. Projektsteuerung: Du planst und steuerst deine Projekte eigenverantwortlich (Budget, Termine, Kommunikation). Bei uns gibt es keine Ebene zwischen dir und dem Kunden. Mitgestaltung: Du bringst deine Erfahrung in unsere Methodik, unsere Automatisierungsprodukte und die Weiterentwicklung des Teams ein. Dein Profil Mehrjährige Erfahrung (ca. 3 - 5 Jahre) als ERP-Consultant, Projektleiter:in oder in vergleichbarer Rolle, egal ob mit weclapp, Business Central, SAP Business One, Xentral oder einem anderen System. weclapp bringen wir dir bei. Ein tiefes, systemübergreifendes Prozessverständnis: Du weißt, wie Warenwirtschaft, Auftragsabwicklung und Finanzbuchhaltung ineinandergreifen und wo es in der Praxis hakt. Erfahrung im direkten Umgang mit Entscheidern in Start-Ups und im Mittelstand: Du kannst zuhören, herausfordern und komplexe Sachverhalte klar erklären. Eine strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise: Mehrere parallele kompakte Projekte bringen dich nicht aus der Ruhe, sondern in deinen Rhythmus. Neugier auf KI und Automatisierung im ERP-Umfeld. Du musst nichts davon können, aber Lust darauf haben. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (Mind. C1-Level) Wir bieten Faire, überdurchschnittliche Vergütung, leistungsbezogene Boni und Weiterbildung nach deinem Bedarf. Wirkung statt Wasserkopf: Kleine, exzellente Firma, kurze Wege, deine Entscheidungen zählen ab Tag eins. Abwechslung als Prinzip: Jedes Projekt ein anderes Unternehmen mit gleichen Mustern — du lernst schneller als in jedem Konzernprogramm. Marktposition: Als führender weclapp-Partner arbeiten wir an den spannendsten Projekten des Ökosystems. Technologievorsprung: Direkter Zugang zu unserer KI-Plattform und den Tools, die wir selbst entwickeln. Flexibilität: Remote-first mit Kundenterminen nach Bedarf, flexible Arbeitszeiten. title: Junior Security Operations Engineering Consultant (m/w/d)
description: It all starts with the mission: NVISO is here to protect European society from potentially devastating cyber attacks! This means we offer cyber security services to private and governmental organizations to help them better prepare for, prevent, detect and respond to cyber security incidents. All of this is built on four fundamental values that define who we are: We are Proud, We Break Barriers, We Care and No BS! Tasks As a Junior Security Operations Engineering Consultant (m/w/d) located in Germany you will assist in various Security Operations Center (SOC) projects. You will gain exposure to SOC engineering concepts such as log onboarding, detection engineering, and SIEM technologies. Under the guidance of senior team members, you will support the design and implementation of security solutions for customers across different sectors. You have strong communication and interpersonal skills, which enable you not only to understand requirements, but also to put these requirements into a development plan, explain it to customers and guarantee proper execution. You have an open and approachable mind, in line with NVISO's values. Typical tasks include but are not limited to: Planning and managing the onboarding of new log sources, troubleshooting issues with log sources or systems with clients and vendors; Creating technical and process playbooks; Defining and setting up correlation rules, based on threat intelligence and specific customer requirements; Contributing to incident response procedures; Ensuring you remain up to speed with latest trends and technologies in the SOC field. You are passionate about cyber security, engineering and automation. Building solutions and working with customers energizes you and you look forward to growing in all the aforementioned domains. Requirements You hold citizenship in one of the 32 NATO member states or the Austrian citizenship; 1-2 years of practical experience (such as a SOC Analyst) in the field of cybersecurity or IT is mandatory; Experience with Azure Sentinel, Microsoft Security stack, or SIEM technologies such as Elastic, Splunk, or LogPoint; Experience with scripting in Python and/or other relevant scripting or automation language is a big plus; Ideally, familiarity with SIEM query languages or an interest in learning Sigma and YARA rules; Experience or coursework related to cybersecurity is beneficial. Soft skills Ability to work independently, and keep track of your priorities; Strong interpersonal and verbal/written communication skills that enable the ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment across the entire company; Excellent English and German communication skills, both verbal and written; A positive, team-oriented, and mission-driven attitude; Ability to prepare and present your work to colleagues. Benefits At NVISO, we care. We are committed to offering you a highly competitive remuneration package including financial and non-financial components: Working and learning from the best people in the European cyber security industry. We have multiple SANS Instructors working at NVISO, our staff has presented at popular hacking conferences (BlackHat, BruCON, OWASP, etc) and all of our technical staff can acquire deep technical security certifications (GSE, GXPN, GREM, GCFA, OSCP, etc); Generous training budget of 10.000 EUR + 10 man days for attending lectures rolling over 2 years; An annual gross base salary between 57.000 EUR and 62.000 EUR, depending on your experience; Support for technical growth with Cloud trainings + certifications (AWS, GCP, Azure); Regular team-building and fun events; Our commitment to coach and counsel you and help you grow; each employee receives a personal coach within the team, whose role is to ensure your well-being and helps you grow in your career! Flexible working hours and home office possibilities (incl. working abroad weeks within the EU); Business Bike Leasing; BahnCard 50 1st class + public transfer ticket; 30 holidays; Cool offices in the center of Frankfurt, Munich and Vienna (with BBQ, kicker table, table tennis, playstations, etc.). raw.title: Senior Python Engineer (m/f/d) - Network Planning
raw.description:
At Flix, we offer a tech-driven environment where innovation meets real-world impact, with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a culture of collaboration and ownership. 

We're looking for an experienced Senior Python Engineer (m/f/d) to join our Supply Division. You'll make an impact by taking ownership of core backend systems that power our network planning optimization product. Your work will directly support network planners in scheduling vehicles, drivers, and timetables — improving travel experiences for millions of passengers while driving profitability. 

Our team builds and maintains an optimization platform addressing use cases from vehicle and driver scheduling to timetable optimization. We follow modern system design — Domain-Driven Design, Hexagonal Architecture, and SOLID principles — with strict architectural boundaries enforced by tooling. Our backend workloads (APIs, event consumers, Kubernetes jobs) are built to scale with high code quality standards. 

The product's algorithm engine is developed by Operations Research Engineers using mathematical optimization. As a Senior Python Engineer, you will own the engineering shell around these algorithms: the APIs, use cases, data pipelines, infrastructure, and the domain models that connect optimization output to the rest of the system. 

You'll collaborate closely with other engineering teams to design and implement the interfaces and contracts that connect our platform to the wider system landscape.

Our current tech stack and toolset include: 

  • Python, TypeScript, Shell scripting 
  • Flask, React, Pytest 
  • PostgreSQL, Confluent Kafka, DataDog 
  • AWS tools, Terraform
  • GitLab, Kubernetes, Docker, Azure AD 

About the Role

  • Own and evolve the backend: APIs, use case layer, domain models, serialization, and event-driven pipelines (Kafka)
  • Take engineering ownership of new product modules — designing the architectural scaffold, wiring layers, and ensuring clean boundaries
  • Build and maintain infrastructure: Kubernetes deployments, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud resources (AWS) 
  • Collaborate closely with Operations Research Engineers to integrate optimization algorithms into the product
  • Work in an AI-augmented development workflow — actively using code agents and AI assistants as a natural part of how you ship software
  • Contribute to architecture decisions and uphold code quality through reviews, testing, and continuous improvement 
  • Write well-tested, self-documenting code following hexagonal architecture patterns
  • Share your expertise and mentor colleagues, promoting a culture of knowledge sharing and learning

About You

  • Academic background in Computer Science or equivalent
  • 5+ years of experience in backend software engineering with Python
  • Experience with modern front-end stack (some basic front-end tasks are part of our scope)
  • Experience applying clean architecture principles (hexagonal, ports-and-adapters, DDD) or similar approaches in production — able to contribute from day one
  • Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL) and event-driven systems (Kafka or similar)
  • Strong experience in AI-augmented development — actively using code agents or AI assistants in daily work
  • Solid experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and CI/CD pipelines
  • Familiar with testing best practices: unit, integration, acceptance testing
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS or similar) and infrastructure as code (Terraform)
  • Familiarity with mathematical optimization or data-intensive applications is a plus

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!  

What We Offer

  • Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family. 
  • Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year. 
  • Hybrid work model: We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life. 
  • Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members. 
  • Learning & Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills. 
  • Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career. 

To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career

Why Join Flix?

At Flix, we empower our teams to push boundaries and shape the future of mobility. As we continue to scale globally, we harness cutting-edge technology to make mobility smarter, more sustainable, and more affordable.

If you're looking for a place where you can drive change and redefine how millions of people travel, Flix is the place where you can lead your journey!
